definitions.explanation: A sudden event causing widespread damage, destruction, or distress, including natural disasters and man-made catastrophes.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{非常食|ひじょうしょく}→非常食：18765_hijoushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared emergency food in case of a disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{災害|さいがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Many people were affected by the natural disaster.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{時|じ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧おこう。

notes:
{災害|さいがい} is a broad term covering both natural and man-made disasters. Japan is particularly prone to ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{災害|さいがい} due to its geography, making disaster preparedness a central part of daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{災害|さいがい}: natural disaster
- {災害|さいがい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: disaster countermeasures
- {災害|さいがい}{時|じ}: at the time of disaster
- {災害|さいがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for disasters
- {災害|さいがい}⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧: disaster relief deployment
- {災害|さいがい}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧: disaster insurance
